notes.title: Avium Update 37.0
notes.notes:
Updates
Avium has a steep learning curve. The bosses and common enemies are challenging enough without the added factor of maintaining control of your War-Suit and its many tools of destruction. 
If you find the default control inputs unsuitable, you can customize the game's available inputs. If you wish to learn more about the default inputs, there are a few helpful menus at your disposal. 

The 'Controls' Tab in the Pause Menu lets you preview what each default input does for your main hero Diezel, while the other 4 playable characters in the game have their own Control Guides. The 'Controls' Window in the Main Menu gives you an overall default input map for Keyboard & Mouse, PlayStation, and Xbox controllers.


Other patches

 You can now quit out of races from the pause menu, letting you restart the race at will.
 Slide Mechanics Bug Fix. Magic and Gun Combat are disabled during sliding.
 Quick Select Mechanics Bug Fix Much smoother swipes between windows, no duplicate windows.
 Updated the Key Rebinding in the Main Menu. 
 Added an on/off toggle for the UI Help Bar that's persistent across most menus. Can be toggled in the Display options from the Main Menu or in the in-game settings from the Pause Menu.

notes.notes:

Back to the action!

 The "War-Suit Unlocked" montages are now skippable! Despite being cool little montages, in the heat of battle, you just might want to move quickly after achieving your new Cosmetic/Ability. This is active for both inside the War-Suit as Diezel and outside of the War-Suit as Jacob.

notes.title: Avium Patch 26
notes.notes:
WHAT'S NEW?

MIND CONTROL:

"This isn't the Vigilante you're looking for."

While under the influence of 4K, mind control can take place with lower rank human enemies. Before, using Telekinesis on enemies from a distance threw them in the air or slammed them down into the ground. But now, on enemies Rank 2 and below, you can see their Faction change to 'Mind Controlled', forcing them to stop targeting you and start targeting every other enemy type in your favor. 

You can suddenly gain allies or meat-shields depending on the situation. But attempting to sway an enemy of higher rank to your side results in the normal telekinesis death, since their minds are less susceptible to conversion and they will die.



Note: You need a vial of 4K to do this.

notes.title: Avium Patch 22
notes.notes:
WHAT'S NEW?

Respawn Camera Rotation Fix! 

 Beforehand, the camera rotation would fail to face the same direction the character's body was facing, resulting in the need for constant manual correction. But now, the camera automatically faces the same direction as the character (in the default third-person position), eliminating the need to correct rotation manually with each respawn.


DLC Content! 

 See Store page for story.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805380/Avium__Valkyrie__Diezel/

 Added 4 New Maps. Updated 2 Maps. 
[olist]
 Starting at the Exclusive Tab in the Main Menu, provided you updated the game, downloaded, and installed the DLC, you now have access to a new window at the bottom of the panel. Selecting this map will take you on the journey that takes place directly after the Main Quest is finished.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720806/a3164adb271131ce7dd29dbb571d3ac7f7f6931e.gif
 UPDATED MAP 01 - Upper Avium
 A) Vanilla content contains the Upper Avium map, but it was originally unlockable only by finishing the main campaign. With the DLC installed, you can now gain access to this map to find out what Diezel intends to do about the untimely demise of Droid. Discover what he's tasked with doing in order to bring back his friend before making his alliance with GAMMA on Mars.

 UPDATED MAP 02 - GAMMA Occupation, MARS
 A) At the end of the campaign, (if you interacted at the right moment), you have access to this Mars map. However, without the DLC installed, this level simply functions as the game's last level before returning you to the title screen. With the DLC installed, you now have the option to wrap up the story of Avium.
 B) As you've seen before, during the tutorial, Jake somehow crash-lands on Mars. This is where and how. Take over as Synthia, the A.I. that powers the Prometheus War-Suit, as you search for said War-Suit and for Jake. Reuniting with him unlocks a New Secret Map!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720806/42ca19c9bd8aef6976195344bd78e79315a87428.png
 NEW MAP 01 - Techknight Territory, ENTERTAINMENT DISTRICT
 A) Play once again as Sarah, but this time, you're taking the fight to the streets of the Entertainment District and against those in control of it: the Techknights. Find and infiltrate their lair to clear the level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720806/96098d438bf32b7993408deb33b72878b7b6bfa7.png
 NEW MAP 02 - Techknight Lair
 A) Your mission is clear: Find the tablet containing proprietary data and the virtual intelligence of the most famous of all Cryo Pilot Influencers. It's the final piece you need it in order to revive a dear friend of yours.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720806/687b1fb981112b7c2ec15c0ff39a8dfdca08be4c.png
 NEW MAP 03 - Hell Maze
 A) Simply navigate the procedural maze (Different every time you visit) to clear the level, but beware! Corrupt copies of you spawn in to stop you.

 NEW MAP 04 - Varrow's Manor, NETHERWORLD
 A) At last, you've reached the end of this journey. Face the last standing remnant of Gorchon's future empire and your most deadly opponent yet: yourself! A corrupt, future version of you who's taken on the name Varrow, in service to the late Gorchon. Defeat him to put an end to this timeline and bring peace to Avium! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720806/df77cc7a2a1f28e79baf2fef1904aea8f6e7f599.png 
[/olist]

 Flames have returned to the exhaust ports during Ultra Sprints (Double Tap Sprint Key/Button)
